timeScope.excluded: All post-finish samples (server idle after normal client drain) excluded from active I/O summaries; only intervals with both monitor wall endpoints in specified run/phase are selected.
timeScope.denominator: Raw OS sampledAt is not present in frozen monitor output. Each original OS deltaSeconds is reconstructed as total raw counter delta / recorded ioOperationsPerSecond, then cross-checked against all 3 stored byte rates. Wall timestamps only locate intervals, approximately 1ms different from underlying OS sample timestamps. Do not derive exact original rates from monitor evaluation timestamps.
timeScope.quantile: Nearest-rank quantiles over recorded interval rates, not I/O operation latency or continuous maxima.

guard.definition: Windows process read/write/other operation rate, including file/network/device/control operations; not physical disk IOPS or storage saturation.

oldFailureComparison.scope: Different fresh realm/admission timing and one short stage. Buffered JSONL is consistent with large write-operation reduction and zero recording errors; no full soak, disk latency, hardware maximum, or exact causal speedup certificate.
